assets.chapter: Ouverture — maison d’hôtes, grenier, combat contre Mia
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: exactly one finished wide 2D fighting-game background master for Resident Evil Combat. Adapt the GUEST HOUSE ATTIC, the original Mia encounter in Resident Evil 7 biohazard (2017), from the supplied actual gameplay screenshot into a lateral combat background. Follow the reference room and materials: low claustrophobic timber attic with exposed dark horizontal laths, rough unfinished planks, tall thick square timber support posts and diagonal roof braces, worn wooden floorboards, loose hanging electrical cables, a pale weathered ladder at the back of the room, a few old wooden boxes and planks behind the playing plane. The walls are bare timber, not ornate plaster; this is not the grand hall of the Baker Main House. Cold dim bluish-grey illumination with a faint pool of light toward the left, dusty humid shadows and restrained horror atmosphere. Remove the human-shaped mannequin and every person, body, monster and weapon. Camera: very wide 2:1 frame, almost straight-on lateral view with coherent shallow perspective; lower quarter forms one continuous unobstructed horizontal wooden combat strip. Keep posts and clutter behind that strip. Detailed semi-realistic game background painting, rich wood grain, convincing decay, clear silhouettes and restrained atmospheric depth. Exactly one continuous room, no montage, no panels, no text, no labels, no HUD, no logos or watermarks. Preserve the visual identity and observed architecture while acknowledging the wide lateral arrangement is a combat-stage adaptation; do not invent decorative architecture or extend into unrelated rooms. Deliver only the opaque stage master.

assets.name: Maison Baker — garage, premier combat contre Jack
assets.chapter: Maison principale — garage, combat contre Jack
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: exactly one finished wide 2D fighting-game background master for Resident Evil Combat. Adapt the BAKER GARAGE of Resident Evil 7 biohazard (2017), the first Jack boss encounter, using the supplied actual gameplay screenshot for the room's architecture, materials and lighting. Depict the battered low concrete-block garage with dirty stained walls, exposed metal ceiling beams, a central cold fluorescent strip light, a heavy curved overhead pipe, chain hoist and hooks, greasy battered shelves and cupboards along the back, small dusty rectangular vents low in the walls, and the wrecked grimy car set behind the fighting plane near the back middle-left. The rear wall has battered boards and torn garage clutter as in the screenshot. Dark desaturated olive-grey and dirty yellow lighting, damp oily concrete, subtle smoke residue. Remove all people, bodies, monsters, weapons and first-person elements; objects may remain as environment props. Camera: very wide 2:1 frame with almost straight-on side view and coherent shallow perspective. Provide one continuous level concrete combat floor across the lower quarter, clear of the car and large props. This is a close low domestic garage, not a huge warehouse, not a car showroom, not an ornate house hallway. Detailed semi-realistic painted game environment, crisp grime, fractured concrete and metal texture, readable supporting shapes without over-bright fantasy lighting. Exactly one continuous scene, no split panels, no map, no text, no HUD, no branding, no logo or watermark. The lateral arrangement is an adaptation of the observed room, not a certified geometric replica. Deliver only the opaque background master.
